g.text: B. Gains and losses by test
A future-step loss gives a small, uncertain gain on the full test
Each dot is one trained GRU. Bars in B show the four-seed mean. Left axis starts at 86%.
Primary mean gain: +0.21 points; descriptive seed interval: −1.02 to +1.13. Three models fail the fixed ability rule.
